Name: Prophet's Bed Replacement for Alternative Textures (unofficial)
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[size=3]This is a conversion of  [CP] [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/19119854]Prophet's[/url] [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7340]Bed Replacement[/url] into a [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720] [/url]mod.

[b][u]All of the art assets inside of this mod belong to [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/19119854]Prophet[/url][/u][/b]; all I did is recolored them and converted to AT. 

Note: I have permission from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2328164] [/url][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/19119854]Prophet[/url][/size][size=3]  to upload it as a separate mod (Thank you for making such a beautiful retexture, Prophet!) [/size]
